newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Aero Ground Services wins two handling contracts.
newsitem.headline: Aero Ground Services wins two handling contracts.

text.p: Aero Ground Services, a leading Schiphol handling company, has won two new cargo handling contracts, the company's marketing manager, Erik Gregory said.
South African Airways (SAA) becomes a customer of the Dutch handling company from February 1 and Swissair Cargo, from March 1.

SAA's freighters will be handled by the Aero Ground Services, while the Dutch national carrier, KLM, will carry out the passenger-side of the handling operation, he added. Avia Presto had formerly carried out SAA's cargo handling.

The Johannesburg-based airline flies twice weekly into Schiphol with Boeing 747-200 freighters and it also operates an Airbus 300 freighter from Harare to Stockholm and this calls at Schiphol on a charter basis.

Aero Ground Services already handled Sabena's cargo from January 1 and the recent Swissair incorporation of Sabena's cargo operations led to this latest move, said Gregory. The passenger operations will be handled by KLM.
Gregory added that the Swissair/Sabena cargo contract will involve trucking mainly. Airport Cargo, a smaller Dutch handler, had previoulsy held the Swissair Cargo contract.
Aero Ground Services handles 35 clients at Schiphol.
"Currently the company has 32,000 square metres of cargo space available but this will increase by another 6,000 sq m by November," he said.
"The company, (in line with Schiphol Airport), has been experiencing growth of around ten percent during 1996," he added. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
